memory: I established the glitch is internal to the external demod: a deterministic, ~0.50 ms phase excursion (~0.19°) locked to the demod update marker. ADC polled mode and varying FPGA decimation ruled out host/DMA and showed update interval scales but excursion duration/amplitude are invariant. Hypothesis: a fixed-time internal processing/firmware event tied to each demod update. Next target: prevent or delay that update and capture internal bus/state during the event.
openQuestion: Which method—update-strobe hold, FPGA clock gate, or firmware single-step—will suppress or alter the demodulator's ~0.50 ms phase excursion when applied?
